'''''Micropus californicus''''' is a plant in the family [[Asteraceae]] which is known by the common name '''slender cottonweed'''. Its flowerheads resemble very small cotton balls, often rounded with cottony white hairs forming the [[Pappus (botany)|pappus]] of each seed. The individual plants are known more informally as '''Q-tips''' due to their resemblance to the [[cotton swab]]s. It is found mostly in California, and into Oregon and northern Baja California. This plant is a resident of the [[vernal pool]] plant community.
